declaration.preface:
To support and align with the environmental vision, sustainability commitments, and strategic objectives of the Anthea Group, DRT-Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. has established this Environmental Sustainability Roadmap as a holistic framework for managing its environmental responsibilities across all business operations.

To facilitate the effective implementation of this Policy, the Company has also developed an internal Environmental Sustainability Roadmap, which translates the Group's environmental priorities into site-specific objectives, targets, action plans, and performance monitoring mechanisms.

DRT-Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. is committed to conducting its manufacturing operations in an environmentally responsible and sustainable manner. As a manufacturer of specialty aroma chemicals, the Company recognizes that effective environmental stewardship is essential to protecting natural resources, minimizing environmental impacts, ensuring regulatory compliance, and creating long-term value for customers, employees, and other stakeholders.

This Environmental Sustainability Roadmap establishes the Company's commitment to integrating environmental considerations into all aspects of its business activities at its manufacturing facilities located at Unit I and Unit II in Roha, Raigad, Maharashtra. The policy provides a framework for managing environmental aspects associated with the use of energy, water, raw materials, chemicals, emissions, waste generation, product stewardship, and customer health and safety throughout the product lifecycle.
declaration.declaration:
The objective of this Environmental Sustainability Roadmap is to establish a comprehensive framework for integrating environmental sustainability into the operations of DRT-Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. and to promote responsible environmental management across all applicable business activities.

Ensure compliance with all applicable environmental laws, regulations, permits, and other statutory requirements.

Prevent pollution and minimize adverse environmental impacts arising from manufacturing operations, products, and services.

Promote the efficient use of natural resources, including water, energy, raw materials, and chemicals, through responsible consumption and continuous improvement.

Reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and improve energy efficiency to support climate change mitigation efforts.

Manage air emissions, wastewater, hazardous and non-hazardous waste, and chemical substances in a safe, responsible, and environmentally sound manner.

Encourage waste minimization, recycling, reuse, and resource recovery in accordance with the principles of the circular economy.

Incorporate product stewardship by considering environmental, health, and safety aspects throughout the product lifecycle, including product use and end-of-life management where applicable.
declaration.scope:
This Environmental Sustainability Roadmap applies to all business activities, manufacturing operations, products, and services of DRT-Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. The policy is applicable to all employees, contract workers, trainees, consultants, and other personnel working on behalf of the Company, as well as visitors and service providers whose activities may have an environmental impact.

The scope of this policy covers all operational areas of the Company, including:

This policy encompasses all activities associated with the manufacturing of specialty aroma chemicals, including procurement of raw materials, storage and handling of chemicals, production processes, utilities, packaging, warehousing, maintenance, laboratory operations, transportation, and product distribution, where applicable.

Energy Efficiency and Climate Change: Enhance energy efficiency across operations by optimizing processes, adopting energy-efficient technologies, increasing the use of cleaner energy sources where feasible, and reducing Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions.

Product Stewardship and Lifecycle Manage: Integrate environmental, health, and safety considerations throughout the product lifecycle, including product development, manufacturing, packaging, transportation, customer use, and end-of-life management, wherever applicable.
Develop a PCF methodology, collect lifecycle data, perform PCF assessments, engage suppliers, and implement
Update SDS, product labels and technical guidance documents.
Customer visits, technical workshops and product guidance.
Periodic review of SDS, labels and regulatory requirements.
Quality control testing, process monitoring and CAPA implementation.
SDS updates, product labels and customer guidance.
Customer awareness, supplier collaboration and recycling initiatives.

Customer Health and Product Safety: Ensure that products are manufactured, handled, stored, and supplied in accordance with applicable quality, environmental, and safety requirements to safeguard customer health and promote the safe use of products.
Product testing, quality assurance and process controls.
Product risk assessments and regulatory reviews.
Process monitoring, laboratory testing and quality assurance.

Environmental Compliance and Risk Manage: Maintain full compliance with applicable environmental laws, regulations, permits, and other compliance obligations while proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating environmental risks associated with operations.

policy.monitoring:
DRT-Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. shall establish and maintain a systematic process for monitoring, recording, and reporting its environmental performance across Unit I and Unit II. Environmental reporting shall include key performance indicators such as water consumption, energy consumption, Scope 1, Scope 2, and where applicable Scope 3 GHG emissions, air emissions, waste generation, recycling, chemical management, environmental incidents, and compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

The EHS Department shall periodically review environmental performance and report progress against the Company's environmental objectives, commitments, and targets to the Management. Environmental data and records shall be maintained to support regulatory compliance, customer requirements, internal audits, management reviews, and continual improvement of the Environmental Management System.
policy.reviewMechanism:
This Environmental Sustainability Roadmap shall be reviewed at least once every year, or earlier if required due to changes in applicable legal and regulatory requirements, business operations, environmental risks, stakeholder expectations, or organizational objectives. The review shall ensure that the policy remains relevant, effective, and aligned with the Company's strategic sustainability goals and environmental commitments.

The review shall be coordinated by the Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Department and approved by the Management. Any revisions arising from the review shall be communicated to all relevant employees and stakeholders, and appropriate actions shall be implemented to support the continual improvement of the Company's Environmental Management System and environmental performance.
